unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: The ruling let span and grade stand, so the row now states the length as resting on a reading; an end review may still want to weigh that reading.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: The unchanged sentence in W5-004 device_notes that no K/Q note and no paseq stand in 9:20-9:23 keeps its older bracket annotation and names no single-witness limit.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: No finding or order named it, so it was left; it is true on the mark layer read here (chapter 9 K/Q at 9:5, 9:12, 9:18, 9:24; paseq at 9:12, 9:13, 9:15, 9:17, 9:18, 9:19, 9:24, 9:27), but it is an absence claim that a later pass may want re-annotated.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: Two annotation styles now stand side by side in the W5 rows: square brackets on untouched sentences and the ordered round-bracket form on changed ones.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: The brief orders the new form only for added or changed sentences; a reader may find the mix uneven.
